https://github.com/galaxyproject/galaxy/pull/18356 Use case is VGP workflows where the reference assembly is constantly being improved until it is finished. A custom genome could work but would need to be manually revised for every assembly update. Possible that this would always be done manually, but fragile and likely to lead to failures from a missing contig in a new assembly so this PR allows a chromosome length file to be supplied. This amalgamates and fixes some built-in converters. Based on CONVERTER_bed_gff_or_vcf_to_bigwig_0 - Test added and dependencies updated to latest versions. Advantage is an optional len file so contigs and lengths are correct at each workflow run for an assembly where dbkey makes no real sense yet. Note that this estimates a bigwig of genome coverage for the intervals in a bed or gff3 - it ignores bed file scores - depth of coverage is what is wanted here. A bed track can be used to inspect scores but this is where the bed has millions of rows and is just too big for scores to be useful as JBrowse2 tracks. * [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular. 
Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format and that's not easy to use downstream.
This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. It also fixes some obvious planemo lint breakage such as redundant name where an argument exist...

Nucmer has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. Both produce _**broken sam headers without tabs**_ - so the headers have to be removed and regenerated from the reference before they can be processed further. Ugly.

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular. 
Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format and that's not easy to use downstream.
This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. It also fixes some obvious planemo lint breakage such as redundant name where an argument exists and missing expected number of outputs for tests...

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 
Nucmer has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. Both produce _**broken sam headers without tabs**_ 
The (always) two lines of broken sam headers are made more acceptable to samtools.
Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 
Nucmer has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. Both produce _**broken sam headers without tabs**_ 
The (always) two lines of broken sam headers are made more acceptable to samtools.
Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse

or cram.

> Also what is the difference between short and long? Should we offer only long?

```The original output format of nucmer, the delta format, contains only the minimum information necessary to quickly recreate the alignment. It contains the name of the matching sequences, the length of the match, number of errors and positions of indels. An important addition in MUMmer4 is option to produce output in SAM format, one of the most widely used formats for alignments of NGS data [[10](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005944#pcbi.1005944.ref010)]. This also allows the MUMmer4 output to be used in any of the numerous tools that require SAM files as input. Nucmer4 supports two different options for SAM format output. With --sam-short, nucmer4 reports only the name of the matching sequence, length, and CIGAR string (which reports the indel positions). With --sam-long, it additionally reports the MD string (which specifies the mismatching positions), the sequence and, if applicable, the quality values of the matching sequence. The long format is more expensive to compute and it generates larger output files, but this option allows nucmer4 to match the behavior of other aligners such as Bowtie2 or BWA.```

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam-short based outputs and added a samtools calmd step to repair Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam-short based outputs and added a samtools calmd step to repair Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam-short based outputs and added a samtools calmd step to repair Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam-short based outputs and added a samtools calmd step to repair Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but more conventional mapping formats would be better for downstream. This PR adds output conversion to sam/bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam-short based outputs and added a samtools calmd step to repair Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed.

* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

CONTRIBUTOR:
* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)
* [X] - This PR updates an existing tool or tool collection

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

Mummer is old and github untouched for >4 years but still seems popular and has a potential use for self-homology mapping in the VGP. Nucmer is the nucleotide mapper. The default output is "delta" format but bam/cram alignment formats would be more useful downstream. This PR adds output conversion to ~sam~bam/cram as an option. 

Nucmer now has `--sam-long` and `--sam-short` output options. 
Both produce _**sam headers with spaces instead of tabs**_ so samtools complains that the header cannot be read unless they are fixed. 

Update: Removed all the sam and the sam-short based outputs and added a routine samtools calmd step to prevent downstream Mummer sam format errors.

~Cannot get gnuplot tests to pass CI here so unless there are strong objections or an easy fix, will remove all the plotting functions and encourage downstream visualisation of the bam/cram with JBrowse~

This is a very stripped-down working prototype, repurposing @hexylena's JBrowse1-in-Galaxy for JBrowse2. 
- JB1 is EOL.
- JB2 configuration json is wildly different from JB1. 
- JB2 defaults are sensible enough for many non-complicated situations.
  - for many workflows like the [TreeValGal](https://github.com/fubar2/treeval_gal) project, this will work very well as is
  - some challenges using jbrowse1 with very dense tracks in huge VGP data. 
- Only the easy part is working for some basic tracks, recycling Helena's core code.
- A _lot of work_ remains, to figure out and implement all the new track configuration options in the UI. 
   - Could not find any human readable documentation on these - need to use the browser to find track setting minutae. 
   - Nor was there anything on changing to different codon schemes that I could find. So that's a big loss - but it might be buried somewhere. The new architecture is plugins to do stuff so might need one for codons.
  - SPARQL, REST ~~and maf tracks~~ remain to be implemented - found a maf plugin so will add that shortly.
 
Screenshot shows some of the test samples in various formats - the blastxml even has a parent!

This is a very stripped-down working prototype, repurposing @hexylena's JBrowse1-in-Galaxy for JBrowse2. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2dev/af3fba6c21aa)

Most things are working in testing - screenshot shows bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- JB1 is EOL.
- JB2 configuration json is wildly different from JB1. 
- JB2 defaults are sensible enough for many non-complicated situations.
  - for many workflows like the [TreeValGal](https://github.com/fubar2/treeval_gal) project, this will work very well as is
  - some challenges using jbrowse1 with very dense tracks in huge VGP data. 
- Only the easy part is working for the basic tracks, recycling Helena's core code, and adding hic.
- URLs are used wherever easy to do to minimise the size of JBrowse2 files folder so these are much smaller than jb1 where all were copied. Not practicable for huge files like hic. JBrowse2 lets galaxy offload existing data and sequence files to nginx range downloads.
- A _lot of work_ remains, to figure out and implement all the new track configuration options in the UI. 
   - Could not find any human readable documentation on these - need to use the browser to find track setting minutae. 
   - Nor was there anything on changing to different codon schemes that I could find. So that's a big loss - but it might be buried somewhere. The new architecture is plugins to do stuff so might need one for codons.
  - SPARQL, REST remain to be implemented.

This is a very stripped-down working prototype, repurposing @hexylena's JBrowse1-in-Galaxy for JBrowse2. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2dev/af3fba6c21aa)

Most things are working in testing - screenshot shows bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- JB1 is EOL.
- JB2 configuration json is wildly different from JB1. 
- JB2 defaults are sensible enough for many non-complicated situations.
  - for many workflows like the [TreeValGal](https://github.com/fubar2/treeval_gal) project, this will work very well as is
  - some challenges using jbrowse1 with very dense tracks in huge VGP data. 
- Only the easy part is working for the basic tracks, recycling Helena's core code, and adding hic.
- URLs are used wherever easy to do to minimise the size of JBrowse2 files folder so these are much smaller than jb1 where all were copied. Not practicable for huge files like hic. JBrowse2 lets galaxy offload existing data and sequence files to nginx range downloads.
- A _lot of work_ remains, to figure out and implement all the new track configuration options in the UI. 
   - Could not find any human readable documentation on these - need to use the browser to find track setting minutae. 
   - Nor was there anything on changing to different codon schemes that I could find. So that's a big loss - but it might be buried somewhere. The new architecture is plugins to do stuff so might need one for codons.
  - SPARQL, REST remain to be implemented.

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made in @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Adds:
- all working json construction without calls to jbrowse cli
- tests for common track types
- working default session 
- Form controlled track options including colour/styling for different track types. 

Removes all #3997 failing tests - most still had JB1 elements so need updating.

* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.
* [X] - License permits unrestricted use (educational + commercial)

This is a very stripped-down working prototype, repurposing @hexylena's JBrowse1-in-Galaxy for JBrowse2. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2dev/af3fba6c21aa)

Most things are working in testing - screenshot shows bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- JB1 is EOL.
- JB2 configuration json is wildly different from JB1. 
- JB2 defaults are sensible enough for many non-complicated situations.
  - for many workflows like the [TreeValGal](https://github.com/fubar2/treeval_gal) project, this will work very well as is
  - some challenges using jbrowse1 with very dense tracks in huge VGP data. 
- Only the easy part is working for the basic tracks, recycling Helena's core code, and adding hic.
- URLs are used wherever easy to do to minimise the size of JBrowse2 files folder so these are much smaller than jb1 where all were copied. Not practicable for huge files like hic. JBrowse2 lets galaxy offload existing data and sequence files to nginx range downloads.
- A _lot of work_ remains, to figure out and implement all the new track configuration options in the UI. 
   - Could not find any human readable documentation on these - need to use the browser to find track setting minutae. 
   - Nor was there anything on changing to different codon schemes that I could find. So that's a big loss - but it might be buried somewhere. The new architecture is plugins to do stuff so might need one for codons.
  - SPARQL, REST remain to be implemented.

* [X] - I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document and this tool is appropriate for the tools-iuc repo.

This is a very stripped-down working prototype, repurposing @hexylena's JBrowse1-in-Galaxy for JBrowse2. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2dev/af3fba6c21aa)

Most things are working in testing - screenshot shows bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- JB1 is EOL.
- JB2 configuration json is wildly different from JB1. 
- JB2 defaults are sensible enough for many non-complicated situations.
  - for many workflows like the [TreeValGal](https://github.com/fubar2/treeval_gal) project, this will work very well as is
  - some challenges using jbrowse1 with very dense tracks in huge VGP data. 
- Only the easy part is working for the basic tracks, recycling Helena's core code, and adding hic.
- URLs are used wherever easy to do to minimise the size of JBrowse2 files folder so these are much smaller than jb1 where all were copied. Not practicable for huge files like hic. JBrowse2 lets galaxy offload existing data and sequence files to nginx range downloads.
- A _lot of work_ remains, to figure out and implement all the new track configuration options in the UI. 
   - Could not find any human readable documentation on these - need to use the browser to find track setting minutae. 
   - Nor was there anything on changing to different codon schemes that I could find. So that's a big loss - but it might be buried somewhere. The new architecture is plugins to do stuff so might need one for codons.

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

#### Merges #5695 derived from @hexylena JBrowse1 tool with most of the improvements made by @abretaud #3997 such as adding track controls to the tool form. 

Sad I didn't know about #3997 until after repeating a lot of the same updates - but that PR included all the track formatting UI form code that #5695 was missing.

Merge adds:
- track json without calls to jbrowse cli - can be more finely controlled.
- added tests for some common track types
- working default session 
- Form has track options including colour/styling for different track types. Expanded UI sample image shown below.
- MAF tracks will work when bcbio-gff is updated when https://github.com/chapmanb/bcbb/pull/141 is accepted

Removes some #3997 tests failing because looking for JB1 elements - need updating. 
Fixes testing in biocontainers - different path in Conda so now use `jbrowse create`. 

Available for testing from the [toolshed](https://toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/view/fubar/jbrowse2/37b2c26c7b9b)

Screenshot shows test bed bam vcf maf bigwig gff sample data tracks
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/82d4e93b-9fe5-43b9-9125-671f110aec96)

and HiC
![image](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/assets/6016266/a440c644-610c-42c2-af6c-3fe62d52dd0e)

- SPARQL and paf remain to be implemented.
- Needs a test for each track input type

- Allow history reference genomes to be used with this converter.
- Update ucsc-wigtobigwig to release 447 - no longer allows stdin so needs the grep output as an input file.

Why: 

- The existing converter can only be used with a built-in reference genome. 
- VGP workflows typically use history reference genomes and bigwig is handy for JBrowse2 to speed up loading times for >10M bed feature tracks.

- Allow history reference genomes to be used with this converter.
- Update ucsc-wigtobigwig to release 447 - no longer allows stdin so needs the grep output as an input file.

Why: 

- The existing converter can only be used with a built-in reference genome. 
- VGP workflows typically use history reference genomes and bigwig is handy for JBrowse2 to speed up loading times for >10M bed feature tracks.

What: 

- Allow history reference genomes to be used to make bedgraph files and thus bigwig tracks.
- Update ucsc-wigtobigwig to release 447 - no longer allows stdin so needs the grep output as an input file.
- Add profile and a citation so it passes planemo lint

Why: 

- The existing converter can only be used with a built-in reference genome. 
- VGP workflows typically use history reference genomes and bigwig is handy for JBrowse2 to speed up loading times for >10M bed feature tracks.

Moving this to the IUC was suggested by @mvdbeek. Ross agrees - the codebase is designed to be flavoured with plugin tools, so removing the other text/genome tools to IUC suites makes a lot of sense since not every server wants or needs them. They will all possibly want the upload tool. Long term, simpler and modular is going to be more sustainable and the IUC can deal with these as they need fixing....
